(rule!
 ;; On an orange(7) field, pick the empty(0) region best aligned with
 ;; the gray(5) block (row overlap >> column overlap >> size, penalized
 ;; by distance). Trim it to its MAIN solid rectangle (the larger of
 ;; the fullest-rows and fullest-cols rectangles; stray cells refill
 ;; orange) and paint magenta(6) along the rectangle edge facing the
 ;; gray block.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define fcells (find-color g 5))
     (define fr0 (min-of first fcells))
     (define fr1 (max-of first fcells))
     (define fc0 (min-of second fcells))
     (define fc1 (max-of second fcells))
     (define (overlap a0 a1 b0 b1)
       (max 0 (+ 1 (- (min a1 b1) (max a0 b0)))))
     (define (score obj)
       (+ (* (overlap (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) fr0 fr1) 100000)
          (* (overlap (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj) fc0 fc1) 100)
          (obj-size obj)
          (- (* (max 0 (- (obj-c1 obj) fc1) (- fc0 (obj-c2 obj)))
                1000))
          (- (max 0 (- (obj-r1 obj) fr1) (- fr0 (obj-r2 obj))))))
     (define (main-rect cells)  ;; the region's dominant solid rectangle
       (let* ((rs (unique (map first cells)))
              (cs (unique (map second cells)))
              (row-count (lambda (r) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                 (= (first p) r))
                                               cells)))
              (col-count (lambda (c) (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                 (= (second p) c))
                                               cells)))
              (a-rows (filter (lambda (r) (= (row-count r)
                                             (max-of row-count rs)))
                              rs))
              (a-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                (all? (lambda (r)
                                        (member? (list r c) cells))
                                      a-rows))
                              cs))
              (b-cols (filter (lambda (c) (= (col-count c)
                                             (max-of col-count cs)))
                              cs))
              (b-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                (all? (lambda (c)
                                        (member? (list r c) cells))
                                      b-cols))
                              rs)))
         (if (>= (* (length a-rows) (length a-cols))
                 (* (length b-rows) (length b-cols)))
             (list (min-list a-rows) (min-list a-cols)
                   (max-list a-rows) (max-list a-cols))
             (list (min-list b-rows) (min-list b-cols)
                   (max-list b-rows) (max-list b-cols)))))
     (let* ((z (select-object-by
                (filter (lambda (o) (and (zero? (obj-color o))
                                         (> (obj-size o) 1)))
                        (objects g 7))
                score 'max))
            (bb (main-rect (obj-cells z)))
            (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
            (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
            (rect (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1))
            (cleared (paint-cells g
                                  (filter (lambda (p)
                                            (not (member? p rect)))
                                          (obj-cells z))
                                  7))
            (dr (- (+ fr0 fr1) (+ r0 r1)))
            (dc (- (+ fc0 fc1) (+ c0 c1))))
       (cond ((>= (abs dc) (abs dr))
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (r) (list r (if (> dc 0) c1 c0)))
                                (range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                           6))
             ((> dr 0)
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c))
                                (range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                           6))
             (else
              (paint-cells cleared
                           (map (lambda (c) (list r0 c))
                                (range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                           6)))))))
